title: Record adopted standing admission, completed larger-batch PPO and failed BC evaluation
summary: The lead adopts exact one- and 128-replica simulation standing admission after the full independent raw audit. Train006 completes 200 PPO updates and 614,400 native transitions, with 142 joint-limit terminations and weak commanded-direction movement; training completion is not gait acceptance. Evaluation012 completes all three selected BC-only probes and fails each; root video review finds no sustained forward walking. Actual PPO evaluation013 is dispatched with results pending. The new Fable follow-up is advisory and not yet adopted. All historical evidence and numerical gates remain unchanged.
next: Assess the actual PPO native probes and pending stability review, then continue toward the unchanged full Stage 2 numerical and human visual requirements.
